description:
Shows which dates of a month are open, one status per date, so you know which dates to ask find_booking_times about.
Use it only for a question that spans weeks; for a day or a few, call find_booking_times directly.

geoHash.description: geoHash of the place, as search_places, get_place and list_my_places return it.

month.description: Month as yyyy-MM in the place's time zone, at most 6 months ahead. Example: 2026-10.

name: get_month_availability

days.description: One entry per date of the month, in order.

status.description: available, partial, fully_booked, closed, unavailable or exceeds_limits.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the place.

title: Month availability
